summary: IIOT-OXYS, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a routine extension (Extension No. 7) of its existing convertible promissory note with GHS Investments LLC. The original $75,000 note from July 29, 2020, had its maturity date extended from April 29, 2026, to October 31, 2026. All prior events of default were waived. No new capital, terms, price, premium, or structural changes were involved. This is a standard debt modification, not a special situation event. It does not fit any special-situations category.
